intro: Captain Greenskin is an elite goblin pirate overseeing the construction and crew of Edwin VanCleef's massive ironclad juggernaut. Hidden deep in the subterranean cove of the Deadmines, he commands the pirate forces hired by the Defias Brotherhood. His goal is to bring the warship to readiness to sail against Stormwind.

p: Pacing the main deck of the gigantic juggernaut under construction in the Deadmines cove, Captain Greenskin represents the naval backbone of the Defias conspiracy. A seasoned goblin mariner, Greenskin was brought into Edwin VanCleef's inner circle to turn an underground cavern into a drydock for an engine of war.

Greenskin does not command an ordinary crew of stonemasons or bandits. Under his direct watch serve seasoned cutthroats, including his fearsome tauren first mate Mr. Smite and the murloc ship's cook, Cookie. Together, they hold the ship's gangplanks and upper deck, standing between intruders and VanCleef's private cabin atop the bridge.
